title: Retry with a deterministic sleeper
summary: Implement bounded retries with capped exponential delays through an injected sleeper and inspectable error wrapping.
objectives: Retry only failures that carry the RetryableError marker.
Compute capped exponential delays and record them without reading the clock.
Preserve the original failure in the returned wrap so errors.Is still works.
constraints: Keep the public Sleeper, Policy, Report, RetryableError, and Run signatures unchanged.
Never call time.Sleep, time.Now, or any other clock source inside Run.
Call the operation exactly once per attempt, with attempt numbers starting at 1.
Record every delay in Report.Delays as a non-nil slice and pass the same delay to Sleeper.Sleep.
Return a non-retryable error unchanged so errors.Is and errors.As still reach it.
When attempts are exhausted, wrap the last error as giving up after {attempts} attempts.

examples.input: MaxAttempts = 3, BaseDelay = 10ms, first attempt returns RetryableError
examples.output: Report{Attempts: 2, Delays: [10ms]} and nil when attempt 2 succeeds
examples.explanation: The delay before attempt 2 is BaseDelay doubled zero times.

examples.input: MaxAttempts = 5, BaseDelay = 10ms, MaxDelay = 25ms, every attempt retryable
examples.output: Delays [10ms, 20ms, 25ms, 25ms], final error "giving up after 5 attempts: ..."
examples.explanation: Delays double until the cap, then stay at MaxDelay.

examples.input: BaseDelay = 0, operation returns retryable twice then succeeds
examples.output: Attempts 3, Delays [], Sleeper.Sleep called zero times
examples.explanation: A non-positive base delay disables sleeping but not retrying.

public.name: Success paths
public.description: First-attempt success and retry-then-success record the correct attempts and delays.

public.name: Exhaustion
public.description: Running out of attempts wraps the last retryable error.

hidden.name: Non-retryable failures
hidden.description: Unmarked and wrapped fatal errors stop immediately and keep their identity.

hidden.name: Delay growth and caps
hidden.description: Delays double per attempt, respect MaxDelay, and disappear for a zero base delay.

hidden.name: Attempt clamping
hidden.description: MaxAttempts below 1 behaves as a single attempt.
